methodology.timing_scope: Production batch with instrumentation, including startup, identity, searches, stats and shutdown; excludes report generation, verification and disk writes
methodology.game_timing_scope: analyze_game only; shared startup/context/shutdown occurs outside per-game times
methodology.overhead_note: Context includes initial metadata and fingerprints; components overlap. Context + per-request metadata + key + get + put is an approximate cache overhead; instrumentation also costs time.
methodology.cohort: Synthetic White-side cohort, not a real single-player history

artifact_note.omitted: Repeated full outputs and player_report objects only. Raw timing components, counters, verification and numerical comparison counts retained. Regenerate the full report with tests/benchmark_optimizations.py before running tests/manual_final_correctness.py on a fresh checkout.
